core_obligations: For nonzero alpha in R the powers 1, alpha, alpha^2, ... lie in R and are linearly dependent over F by algebraicity (finite-dimensionality of F(alpha))

proof_roadmap: Extract a vanishing relation among the powers inside R
Normalize the constant term and read off the inverse
